Subject: Key provisions under the Code on Social Security, 2020- reg.
Sir/Madam,
The Code on Social Security, 2020 has been enforced on 21.11.2025 with the
objective to consolidate and simplify the existing social securitylaws into a single
framework and to extend social security coverage to all workers, including organized,
unorganized, gig, platform, and self-employed workers, by ensuring universal access to
social security benefits, promoting portability of benefits across employments and
States, enabling the Central and State Governments to frame appropriate schemes,
leveraging tcchnology for efficient delivery, and clearly defining the roles of
governments, employers, and aggregators in order to provide comprehensive social
protection to the workforce in line with evolving labour market conditions.
2.
The Sections 154, 155 & 159 and 156 defines the power of Appropriate
Government (Central/State),Central Government and State Government to make rules
under the Code on Social Security, 2020. Thc details of sections on which rules are to
be made by these Governments in their capacity as Appropriate Government, Central
Government and State Government are given in Annexure A, B, C and D respectively,
for reference. The details of sections on which Central Government will make schemes
are also given in Annexure E.
